sections.markdown:
## F — Driver fitness and impairment
Research index: knowledge and continuation facts are in C and C2 for Driver fitness and impairment. Each fact resolves to a single source page, with accepted identifiers preserved for downstream compilation.
VERIFY list:
- MT-sec12-COUNT: official question count unknown.
- MT-sec12-PASS: official passing standard unknown.
- MT-sec12-TIME: official time limit unknown.
- MT-sec12-EDITION: reconcile cover and back-cover revision statements.
- MT-sec12-UNDERAGE-BAC: Physical page eighty-two prints zero point zero two for drivers under twenty-one without an explicit percent unit on that sentence; preserve numeric unit and current applicability as unknown until exact official confirmation.
- MT-sec12-ALCOHOL-AGE: The blanket alcohol-purchase/consumption age sentence on page eighty-two does not describe statutory exceptions. Current purchase versus consumption scope requires official statutory confirmation before a blanket rule is asserted.
- MT-sec12-DUI-PENALTIES: Monetary DUI amounts, jail ranges and suspension terms on physical page eighty-two require current statutory applicability and conviction classification before assertion.
- MT-sec12-ALCOHOL-PHYSIOLOGY: One-minute absorption and average one-drink-per-hour processing estimates on physical page eighty-one lack individual-condition support and must never become a sobriety timer.
- MT-sec12-UNDATED-STATISTICS: Alcohol-crash proportions and program success figures on pages eighty-one/eighty-two, hearing comparisons on page eighty and age-based crash rankings on page eighty-four lack dated underlying studies.
- MT-sec12-REPORT-CONTACT: The reporting telephone number on physical page eighty-two needs current official verification before being displayed.
- MT-sec12-MEDICAL-SPECIFICS: Insulin-adjustment, shock, eye-disease and untreated cardiovascular-condition instructions on physical page eighty-three require current clinically qualified evidence for individual applicability; no clinical clearance or dose rule is asserted.
- MT-sec12-EYE-CHECK-INTERVAL: The suggested periodic eye-exam interval on physical page eighty is medical screening guidance without individual risk conditions; current clinician guidance is needed before a universal interval is asserted.
- MT-sec12-SURRENDER-ID-FEES: Free-versus-paid identification-card conditions after surrender on physical page eighty-five depend on current fee/eligibility rules; no amount or entitlement is asserted.
- MT-FITNESS-MARKET: market evidence missing.
- MT-FITNESS-TEARDOWN: competitor evidence missing.
Dynamic isolation: Current alcohol-law exceptions, penalty amounts, reporting contacts and medical licensing applicability require current official evidence; individual fitness is not inferred from age alone.
